description: Source code for a GTK widget 'CcTimezoneMap' that displays a world map with timezone information, allowing user interaction to select timezones and display related info.

classes.name: CcTimezoneMap
classes.description: GTK widget for displaying and interacting with timezone map, including location selection and display.

methods.description: Creates a new instance of CcTimezoneMap widget.
